meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: Claude 会扮演安装医生,检查本地 LazyCodex 和 Codex 的安装,拉取最新源码做对比,检查版本、配置和插件,输出每条都有证据的 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告,并给出修复建议;诊断过程中不改动用户安装。
howto.when: 当用户要求做安装健康检查,提到 LazyCodex、omo-codex 等关键词,或怀疑 Codex 安装过期/损坏时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查一下 LazyCodex 的安装是否健康
say.note: 会拉取最新源码并对比本地,给出报告。

say.text: Codex 升级后一直报错,帮我诊断下
say.note: 检查版本、配置和插件,判断是否过期或漂移。

say.text: 对比一下本地安装和最新版的差异
say.note: 会逐项比文件并附证据。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as an install doctor: fetches latest LazyCodex/Codex sources, inspects local install, compares versions/config/plugins, outputs PASS/WARN/FAIL with evidence and fixes; never modifies user install during diagnosis.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a health check, mentions LazyCodex, omo-codex, etc., or suspects a stale, drifted, or broken Codex install after updates/config changes.

say_en.text: Check if my LazyCodex install is healthy.
say_en.note: Fetches latest sources and compares with local install.

say_en.text: Codex now errors after upgrade, please diagnose.
say_en.note: Checks versions, config and plugins for staleness or drift.

say_en.text: Compare my local install with the latest version.
say_en.note: Diffs files item by item with evidence.
